book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Luke wana Leleli

content: Diyon Tobabitaiso wana Papaatena

Sauga toto Sisa Taibeliyas wana sauga logugui ana baliman piptin elana, Pontiyas Pilato i gavana labi Yudiya elana, Helodi i tologugui labi Galili elana, talina Pilipi i tologugui labi Ituliya ge Telekonitis elal, Lisaniyas i tologugui labi Abilini elana,
ge Anasa alona Kaiyapa heliya topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa. He saugena o Diyon Sakalaiya natuna i miminaa uleya labi kekevana elana inoke Yehoba anana i gan elana.
Yaka i na panuwa gegewel elal bolo hi minaa wewel Yolidani labenaa, ge i papaatena gamagalau elal i ba, “Wami pagan nanakina ana en nuku pek ge nuku babitaiso, inoke Yehoba wami gegi ni nuwayoho.”
I masal i ola toto palopita Aiseya i lelelian wana buki gamwanaa, i ba:

content.text: Gamagal etega to i yogayoga uleya labi kekevana elana, i ba,
oya ge manahinhin gegewel nuku ken lowagil ni olaolaek.
Kamwasa bolo hi lilikomkom nuku ken pasapu,
ge kela bolo lohalhalina nuku pasapusapu.
Inoke gamagalau gegewel Yehoba wana pwamwal nihi kite.”

content: Boda bwabwatana hi nowanik hi na Diyon elana tage ni pababitaisoil, inoke i baek elal i ba, “Komiu ku ola mwata! Henala i baewa eliyamiu ge nuwamiu Yehoba wana lahi toto i nenem nuku louwi?

Ebo tunahot wami gegi iyaka ana en ku pek, he enona ni masal yawalimiu elana. Bahi tage nuku ba, ‘Ama tamama Abalahama, bosowaima ya te Yehoba wana lahi naha louwi.’ Na baewa eliyamiu, Yehoba i bosowaina te pat ya ni ahel ge Abalahama tubunau ni ginolil.
He wana kenumu iyaka i lovivina-an ebwakil ewahililiya ni gotomwa ge nihi maguli. Ebwakil gegewel bolo enowaliya nige i wawaisi ni govel ge ni yoho tukagil ginaha gamwanaa.”
Yaka boda hi nel Diyon elana hi ba, “He binimala hauna gun naha ginol?”
Analiya i lahe i ba, “Henala ebo ana holahola eluwa, he etega ni guyauan toto nige ana holahola i gagan elana, ge henala ebo aana i gan, ni ginol ni ola al to.”
Takis ana toahi enuna hi nok hi na tage ni pababitaisoil, inoke hi nel elana hi ba, “Topankite, binimala hauna naha ginol?”
Yaka wali nel i lahe i ba, “Bahi takis nuku aahe likaan gamagalau elal, yaa ana bwata toto logugui i baunan te nuku ahe.”

Tolohaveyan enuna hi nel elana hi ba, “Yaa ga i ola ama? Binimala hauna naha ginol?” Yaka wali nel al i lahe i ba, “Bahi gamagalau nuku papalawakikil ge wali mani nihi pepewa, ge bahi nuku wowolel kakawel ge nihi pwapwamolamiu, yaa besena te molamiu toto ku aahe elana nuku minaa.”
He gamagalau Mesaiya wana nem kaiwena hi matamatan, inoke ateliyaa hi nuwatu ge hi nel hi ba, “Diyon iya Mesaiya eba?”

Yaa Diyon i baek gegewel elal i ba, “Nau ya pababitaisomiu wewel elana, yaa etega iyoho i nenem iya alana i bwata hot, nau alau nige i bwabwata. Nau nige no waisi i gagan tage bosowaiu aena ana os ana hihiu na leke. He iya abwe ni pababitaisomiu Yayaluwa Bwabwalena ge ginaha elana.

Wana sobel iyoho i pihikan nimanaa, yaka i tetelipuna wana witi enona alona ge musana ni ase, inoke abwe enona hot ni bugulan ni teliya wana gonuwa, ge musana ni ton ginaha elana toto nige sauga etega ni bobolu.”
He Diyon baaba ololana o hi gewi i baunanagil, inoke eliyana gamagalau i ba pagasisel ge wasa waiwaisana i papaatena-an elal.
Yaa Helodi, Galili wali tologugui, wana pagan nanakina Diyon i baunanek eliyana, kaiwena talina lagona Helodiyas i oe ge pagan nanakina hi gewi al i ginolil.
Inoke Helodi wana pagan nanakina i paetulan al ge Diyon i yowan i paulutuk-an dela.
Diyon Yeisu I Pababitaiso
Sauga Diyon gamagalau gegewel i pababitaisoil, inoke Yeisu al i pababitaiso. He Yeisu iyoho i awaawanun inoke labulabum i mwapwela,
yaka Yayaluwa Bwabwalena ana awa i ola bunibuni i lau elana. Ge anan etega i loem labulabumwa i ba, “Owa natu nunuwanina hot, ya yaliyaya nabiyan kaiwem.”
Yeisu ana Lihu
Sauga Yeisu wana baliman tabam i ola teti (30), inoke abwe wana tuwalali i telipuna. He gamagalau hi nuwatu te Yeisu tamana Yosepa. Yosepa tamana Heli,
Heli tamana Madati, Madati tamana Libai, Libai tamana Meleki, Meleki tamana Yanai, Yanai tamana Yosepa,
Yosepa tamana Madatiyas, Madatiyas tamana Emos, Emos tamana Neiham, Neiham tamana Esili, Esili tamana Nagai,
Nagai tamana Madi, Madi tamana Madatiyas, Madatiyas tamana Semeina, Semeina tamana Yoseki, Yoseki tamana Yoda,
Yoda tamana Yowanani, Yowanani tamana Lesa, Lesa tamana Selababel, Selababel tamana Seyaltiyel, Seyaltiyel tamana Neli,
Neli tamana Meleki, Meleki tamana Adi, Adi tamana Kosami, Kosami tamana Elimadam, Elimadam tamana Eli,
Eli tamana Yosuwa, Yosuwa tamana Eliyesa, Eliyesa tamana Yolim, Yolim tamana Madati, Madati tamana Libai,
Libai tamana Simiyon, Simiyon tamana Yuda, Yuda tamana Yosepa, Yosepa tamana Yonam, Yonam tamana Elayakim,
Elayakim tamana Meleya, Meleya tamana Mena, Mena tamana Matada, Matada tamana Neitan, Neitan tamana Deibid,
Deibid tamana Diyesi, Diyesi tamana Obedi, Obedi tamana Bowasa, Bowasa tamana Salimon, Salimon tamana Nason,
Nason tamana Aminadab, Aminadab tamana Edmin, Edmin tamana Ani, Ani tamana Hesiloni, Hesiloni tamana Peles, Peles tamana Yuda,
Yuda tamana Yakobo, Yakobo tamana Aisake, Aisake tamana Abalahama, Abalahama tamana Tela, Tela tamana Naho,
Naho tamana Selag, Selag tamana Liu, Liu tamana Peleg, Peleg tamana Ebe, Ebe tamana Sela,
Sela tamana Keinan, Keinan tamana Apakad, Apakad tamana Semi, Semi tamana Nowa, Nowa tamana Lemeki,
Lemeki tamana Metuisela, Metuisela tamana Inok, Inok tamana Yaledi, Yaledi tamana Mahalalil, Mahalalil tamana Keinan,
Keinan tamana Inosi, Inosi tamana Seti, Seti tamana Adama, Adama tamana Yehoba.
